headline.size_rel: ~9-10% of frame height per line, 2 lines max

caption.family_guess: same as headline, no separate caption face — captions ARE the headline

layout.host_pos: dead-center, face fills ~55% frame width, shot from chest-up, static tripod/webcam, zero camera movement
layout.safe_zones: top 8% and bottom 8% kept clear of face; caption block sits in lower third (~72-92% of frame height)
layout.caption_pos: bottom-center, 2 lines max, centered, stacked directly above bottom safe margin

transitions: none — single continuous static shot, all motion is host's natural talking gesture (hand points, praying-hands emphasis at payoff beat)

themeable: accent (keyword highlight color) — swap per channel brand
accent2 (secondary highlight, used sparingly) — swap per channel brand
bg (host's real background) — not directly controllable if using real talking-head footage, but if recreated with a virtual host this becomes swappable
caption font family — swap for brand type as long as weight stays ultra-bold + all-caps
wardrobe/backdrop — content-specific, not part of the reusable look
